   - Category: Multi-Tenant Cloud Software

   - Scale: 1,000+ active users, 136,000+ cards generated, 86,000+ bulk downloads.

2. VidyaMaxx (AI School Management Platform)
   - Category: Educational ERP & AI Automation

   - Key Features: Real-time academic tracking, automated report card generation, AI-powered student diagnostic insights, and role-based portals.

3. PrintNexx (Automated Media Processing Pipeline)
   - Category: Desktop & Automated Utilities
   - Purpose: Industrial image processing and automated card layout tool for physical printing presses.
   - Key Features: High-throughput batch image alignment, automated color correction, CMYK color space handling, and PDF spooling.
   - Technologies: Python, OpenCV, Pillow, PyQt.
   - Case Study URL: https://logicbyroshan.in/projects/printnexx

4. EazeTrip (Travel Management SaaS)

   - Technologies: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB.

5. TaskFlixx (AI Task Automation)
   - Category: Developer Tooling & Productivity
   - Purpose: Context-aware task scheduling and developer workflow automation.
   - Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, OpenAI API.

6. PrepSarthi (AI EdTech Adaptive Assessment)
